scope: Map Data option SQL family plus treasure selector and dispatch level persisted-search predicates

optionSql.alliances: city alliance_name counts ordered by alliance_name COLLATE NOCASE then alliance_name
optionSql.names: resource/monster name-key counts grouped by kind/name_key with empty keys excluded and NOCASE ordering
optionSql.dispatchLevels: distinct integer level values >= 1 ordered ascending
optionSql.treasureTypes: supplies rows use suppliesType>0 with treasureType normalized to 0; ordinary treasure rows use treasureType with suppliesType normalized to 0; grouped counts have stable recovered ordering
optionSql.rewardItems: truck/railway currentGoods key/name/icon groups are ordered by name NOCASE then key, with an unresolved arriveTs cutoff parameter
optionSql.scanProgress: newest non-discarded scan_runs row for the selected server ordered by updated_at descending

behavior: treasure selected-option query accepts exactly the recovered paired dimensions: one positive value and a zero sentinel for the other
ordinary treasureType filtering also applies the recovered suppliesType=0 guard
dispatch selected level applies the recovered >= and <= predicates to the same frontend-emitted level
unsupported time-dependent and incompletely mapped branches remain MAP_QUERY_UNRECOVERED

checks: fresh reference and frontend SHA-256 verification
bounded raw-byte printable-ASCII inspection of the listed PE ranges
validation.result: RECOVERED static plus IMPLEMENTED/OFFLINE-TESTED; no live scan or native ingestion claim

completionStatus and plunderableOnly clock/parameter mapping remains unresolved
